title: Cleaning, Washing, and Metal Pickling Equipment Operators and Tenders
description: Operate or tend machines to wash or clean products, such as barrels or kegs, glass items, tin plate, food, pulp, coal, plastic, or rubber, to remove impurities.

projection.title: Cleaning, washing, and metal pickling equipment operators and tenders

tasks.text: Add specified amounts of chemicals to equipment at required times to maintain solution levels and concentrations.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying solutions to equipment is manual

tasks.text: Observe machine operations, gauges, or thermometers, and adjust controls to maintain specified conditions.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Instrument monitoring needs physical sensor presence

dwas.name: Monitor instruments to ensure proper production conditions.

tasks.text: Set controls to regulate temperature and length of cycles, and start conveyors, pumps, agitators, and machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual temperature control adjustment

dwas.name: Adjust temperature controls of ovens or other heating equipment.

tasks.text: Drain, clean, and refill machines or tanks at designated intervals, using cleaning solutions or water.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of equipment in unstructured settings

tasks.text: Operate or tend machines to wash and remove impurities from items such as barrels or kegs, glass products, tin plate surfaces, dried fruit, pulp, animal stock, coal, manufactured articles, plastic, or rubber.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on control of industrial machinery in unstructured settings

tasks.text: Record gauge readings, materials used, processing times, or test results in production logs.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

tasks.text: Examine and inspect machines to detect malfunctions.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical inspection of production machinery in situ

tasks.text: Measure, weigh, or mix cleaning solutions, using measuring tanks, calibrated rods or suction tubes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical measuring and dispensing of ingredients

dwas.name: Measure ingredients or substances to be used in production processes.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Mix substances to create chemical solutions.

tasks.text: Draw samples for laboratory analysis, or test solutions for conformance to specifications, such as acidity or specific gravity.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Chemical/physical testing requires lab manipulation

dwas.name: Test chemical or physical characteristics of materials or products.
Collect samples of materials or products for testing.

tasks.text: Adjust, clean, and lubricate mechanical parts of machines, using hand tools and grease guns.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual lubrication of production equipment

tasks.text: Load machines with objects to be processed and unload them after cleaning, placing them on conveyors or racks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically extracting parts from production equipment

dwas.name: Remove products or workpieces from production equipment.
